offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests；base price includes up to 10 results. Each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /search，基础价（每请求最多10个结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Standard search results: URLs and page contents; highlights, structured outputs, and AI Summary.
offerings.note: Additional results and Exa-generated page summaries are billed on top.
